Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Why willpower keeps failing"

Hook
"Most follow-through advice is really just willpower advice in a nicer outfit. Here's why that matters." (to camera, outdoors with greenery, red top like your profile)
Body
"A lot of systems assume motivation shows up on schedule. For many ADHD adults, it doesn't. So the system breaks, and people blame themselves. What I teach starts somewhere else: seeing the finish before you start, with short guided visualizations." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I'm teaching the whole method in a live 90-minute class called Untamed Follow-Through. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"The 60-second reset"

Hook
"Here's a 60-second exercise I'd try before any task that keeps getting pushed to tomorrow." (Ana closes her eyes, soft music)
Body
"Picture the task already done. Where are you sitting? What does the finished thing look like? How does your body feel? Now picture the very first small step. That's the only thing to do next." (caption for each line)
CTA
"That's one piece of the method. I teach the full thing in my live masterclass, Untamed Follow-Through. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"From teacher to ADHD coach"

Hook
"I spent years as a teacher before I became an ADHD coach. Here's the thing the classroom taught me about follow-through." (walking, natural light)
Body
"The people who finished weren't the ones with the most discipline. They were the ones who could picture where they were going and had a clear next step. That's what I build with late-diagnosed adults now, using guided visualizations."
CTA
"The class is called Untamed Follow-Through, it's $17, and there's a replay if live doesn't work. Tap Sign up."
